title: DUKH, DARD, PEEDA: Life After 30s | StandUp Comedy by Rahul Dua | Mid Life Crisis | 2026
description:
Allow Me India Tour - ONE LAST TIME. Tickets: https://linktr.ee/therahulduatour

Turning 30 is a major milestone, until your body files an FIR and protests against you. 😉 

Digestion, fashion, joints, fitness - all gone. 69 in bed has a new meaning altogether. People above 30 will relate hard, and people under 30 pls be prepared. 

Pls SHARE the video with those friends who feel the same. Pls LIKE the video as it really helps in pushing the reach, and COMMENT with your most favourite joke from this video. Aur aaye hi ho SUBSCRIBE ho jaaye? 

For regular bite size content: https://www.instagram.com/therahuldua/
